```{r setup, include=FALSE}

knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggpubr)
library(DescTools)


```

```{r }
df <- read_excel("~/Documents/Experiments/11.4.26 EY123 mScarlet.xlsx", 
    sheet = "Sheet1")

newdf<- df %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarize(across(A1:G11, max)) 
result <- df %>%
  group_by(ID) %>%
  summarise(across(A1:G11,sum))

#newdf1<- result %>%
  #slice(seq(from = 1, to = n(), by = 2))
#newdf2 <- result %>%
  #slice(seq(from = 2, to = n(), by = 2)) 

newdf1<- newdf %>%
  slice(seq(from = 1, to = n(), by = 2))
newdf2 <- newdf %>%
  slice(seq(from = 2, to = n(), by = 2))

min <-c(0,7.5,15,22.5,30,37.5,45,52.5,60,67.5,75,82.5,90,97.5,105,112.5,120,127.5,135,142.5,150,157.5,165,172.5,180,187.5,195,202.5,210,217.5,225,232.5,240,247.5,255,262.5,270,277.5,285,292.5,300,307.5,315,322.5,330,337.5,345,352.5,360,367.5,375,382.5,390,397.5,405,412.5,420,427.5,435,442.5,450,457.5,465,472.5,480,487.5,495,502.5,510,517.5,525,532.5,540,547.5,555,562.5,570,577.5,585,592.5,600,607.5,615,622.5,630,637.5,645,652.5,660,667.5,675,682.5,690,697.5,705,712.5,720,727.5,735,742.5,750,757.5)

i <- cbind(newdf1,min)
j <- cbind(newdf2,min)

```

```{r Scarlet Lum 1}
colors <- c("Alive" = "steelblue", "Control" = "black", "Dead" = "red", "Delayed Dead"="purple")

p <- ggplot(i, aes(x=min)) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A1, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A3, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A5, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A7, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A9, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = A11, color="Control")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C1, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C3, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C5, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C7, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C9, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = C11, color="Control")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = E1, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = E3, color="Alive")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = E5, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = E7, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = E9, color="Alive")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = E11, color="Control")) + 
  #geom_line(aes(y = G1, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = G3, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = G5, color="Dead")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = G7, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = G9, color="Alive")) + 
  geom_line(aes(y = G11, color="Control")) + 
  labs(title="EY123 Lum",
        x ="Time (min)", y = "Luminescence (AU)", color = "Legend")+
    scale_color_manual(values = colors)
p
#ggsave("EY123 Lum.png")

```

```{r AUC1}


my_vec <- numeric()



for (col in j) {
    a <- AUC(min, col, method = c("trapezoid"))
    my_vec <- c(my_vec, a)
}

```

```{r Graph1}
df <- data.frame(dose=c("Dead","Alive","Alive","Alive","Alive","Control","Alive","Alive","Alive","Dead","Alive","Control","Alive","Alive","Dead","Alive","Alive","Control","Alive","Dead","Alive","Alive","Control"),
    len=c(11520.00,  11925.00,  15367.50,  20816.25,  21026.25,  22387.50,  14741.25,  31728.75,  27948.75,  36165.00, 12948.75,  10091.25,  15356.25,  24476.25,  17501.25,  14291.25,  11730.00,  13128.75,  11516.25,  19980.00, 13140.00,  23002.50,  13132.50))

    
my_comparisons <- list(c("Alive", "Dead"),c("Alive", "Control"))

p <- ggplot(df, aes(x=dose, y=len)) +
geom_bar(stat="summary", 
           fun=mean,
           aes(fill=dose)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2), color = "black")+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#00BFC4","#7CAE00", "#F8766D","#C77CFF"))+
  stat_compare_means(comparisons = my_comparisons)+
  labs(title="EY123 Fluor AUC",
        x ="Condition", y = "Area Under Curve")
p


#ggsave("EY123 FAUC.png")
```

```{r Combine Fluor}
  mutate(across(-min, ~ . - m))
```

```{r smoothing}


p <- ggplot(sj1, aes(x=min)) + 
  geom_smooth(aes(y = A1, color="Dead"), method = "gam", span = 0.2) +
```
